version: 0.4.0
kind: schema
schema_type: shared

metadata:
  udi: prismata.meta.schema.shared-geometry
  name: shared-geometry.schema
  description: Shared geometry fields for coordinate systems, alignment, and scaling.

spec:
  target_kind: geometry
  naming:
    file_suffix: .schema.yaml
  versioning:
    semver: true

fields:
  - name: x
    path: x
    type: integer
    required: false

  - name: y
    path: y
    type: integer
    required: false

  - name: width
    path: width
    type: integer
    required: false

  - name: height
    path: height
    type: integer
    required: false

  - name: align
    path: align
    type: string
    required: false

  - name: scale
    path: scale
    type: string
    required: false

object:
  x: 0
  y: 0
  width: 100
  height: 100
  align: ""
  scale: ""
